identification: French gilt-brass corniche carriage clock, timepiece only (single winding square on the back plate, no strike, repeat button or alarm), white enamel dial with Roman hours and Arabic five-minute outer track, bevelled glasses and oval top window over the lever platform, about 15 cm with handle up. Early 20th century, about 1900-1920. With its crank key and the original leather-covered travelling case (red velvet lined, leather badly worn and split at the corners and edges). Running state unknown. Current bid A$75, estimate A$150-200.
